title: Length, mass & capacity units
examples: Teacher, when should I use centimeters instead of meters?
What is the difference between grams and kilograms?
If I need to measure juice, which unit should I pick?

explain.say: Today we learn about measuring things around us. We look at length, mass, and capacity. These are ways to measure size.
For length, we use millimeters, centimeters, meters, and kilometers. These units help us measure how long something is.
A good example is measuring a pencil. We use centimeters for this small object.
For mass, we measure weight using grams and kilograms. Think of measuring things like apples or bags of sugar.
For capacity, we measure how much liquid fits. We use milliliters and liters for this job.

faq.q: When do I use millimeters for length?
faq.a: You use millimeters for very small measurements. Think about the width of a small coin or a crayon.
asks: What is the smallest length unit?
When is mm the right unit to pick?

faq.q: Should I use grams or kilograms for weight?
faq.a: Use grams for light things, like a few paper clips. Use kilograms for heavier things, like a person or a large bag of rice.
asks: Which unit is better for a puppy?
Is it always better to use kilograms?

faq.q: What is the difference between ml and L?
faq.a: Milliliters are for small amounts of liquid. Liters are for bigger amounts, like a bottle of soda or milk.
asks: How do I measure a small drink?
When should I use the big unit, liters?

faq.q: How do I choose the right unit?
faq.a: Look at the object you measure. If it is very small, use the smaller unit. If it is big, use the larger unit.
asks: Do I always go big or small?
What helps me decide which unit to pick?

faq.q: Can I mix units when measuring?
faq.a: No, you must stick to one type of unit for one measurement. For length, only use length units.
asks: Can I measure length in grams?
Do I need to change units when I measure?

facts: A meter is equal to one hundred centimeters.
One kilogram is equal to one thousand grams.
One liter is equal to one thousand milliliters.
Kilometers measure long distances, like between cities.

quiz.say: To measure the length of a classroom, should you use centimeters, meters, or millimeters?
quiz.why: Meters are the best unit because a classroom is a medium-sized object.

wrong.1: This is tempting because centimeters are also for length, but they are too small for a room.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it is a unit of length, but it is far too small for a classroom.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it is a big unit, but kilometers are for measuring between towns.

quiz.say: If a bag of sugar weighs one thousand grams, what is its mass in kilograms?
quiz.why: Because one thousand grams make one whole kilogram, the answer is one kilogram.

wrong.0: This mistake happens when you multiply by one thousand instead of dividing.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you are dividing by one hundred, not ten.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you need to move up to the next larger unit, the kilogram.

quiz.say: A small juice box holds two hundred milliliters. How many milliliters is that in liters?
quiz.why: Since one liter is one thousand milliliters, two hundred milliliters is two hundred over one thousand.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you multiplied by one thousand instead of dividing.
wrong.1: This is confusing because it mixes word descriptions with the correct decimal form.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you added the units instead of dividing by one thousand.
